# WebTranslate HaYTooL

> Ultra-lightweight, zero-telemetry, privacy-first web page and text translator browser extension for Chromium browsers (Chrome, Edge, Helium Browser, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi).

## Core Capabilities
- Live progress full webpage translation without layout breaking.
- Floating HUD instant translation for selected text with dual original/translated views.
- 6 Translation Engines: Google Translate, DeepL AI, Bing Translator, DuckDuckGo, MyMemory, Lingva.
- Engine Arena: Real-time side-by-side benchmarking of all 6 engines comparing speed (ms) and quality.
- 6-Tab Multi-Engine Live Comparison: Opens active URL in 6 tabs simultaneously across all engines.
- Domain Blacklist / Exclusions: Prevent translation on banking, intranet, or code repository websites.
- Zero telemetry and 100% client-side privacy: No translation history or user data stored remotely.
- 45+ world languages supported with bidirectional quick swap (⇄).

## Technology Stack
- Standard: Manifest V3 (MV3)
- Language: Vanilla ESNext JavaScript, Vanilla Modern CSS (Glassmorphism, WCAG AA 4.5:1+)
- Frameworks: Zero heavy frameworks (no React/Vue), instant startup, zero latency.
